name: paper-craft
vibe: A warm handcrafted cut-paper / papercraft film. A cream paper ground carrying soft drifting construction-paper shapes with soft drop-shadows, a paper grain and a soft top light flows unbroken across every cut. Layered paper sheets pop up and fold in with a tactile bounce; screenshots are pasted onto warm paper photo-cards with a soft shadow, a strip of tape and a slight rotation; stats pop off the page on paper discs; feature chips are paper tags; a paper-button CTA closes. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole collage — every paper tint, the accent ink, the highlight sheet, the cut-out photo wash and the CTA button, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for warm, playful, premium-craft brands, storybook product tours, screenshots and anything that should feel made by hand.
